:::{#def-reducible-risk}
#### Reducible risk

The **reducible risk** of a [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn$
is the [expectation](#def-expectation) of the squared difference
between $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ and the [conditional mean](#def-cond-expectation-function) $\truemeanf{\Predvar}$ of the [outcome](#def-outcome):

$$\E{\sqf{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}}$$

:::
